notice.title: Schedule for certificate verification of Pharmacist (Ayurveda)

clauses.text: The candidates are called for verification of certificates / documents based on the particulars furnished in their on-line applications such as age, educational qualification, community, etc

The provisional selection of candidates will be made only after verification/ acceptance of certain documents, educational qualification possessed by him/her, clarification regarding community status and its acceptance, marks / rank list of the candidate etc. as the case may be

Evidence and Mark sheets of Educational qualification (SSLC, HSC and Diploma course in Indian System of Medicine / Diploma in Pharmacy (Ayurveda) / Diploma in Integrated Pharmacy conducted by Government of Tamil Nadu) c
